title: Second filtration by subcomplexes for a half-plane-supported bicomplex
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $J$ an integer-indexed cochain bicomplex with a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $b\in\mathbf Z$. Assume $J^{i,j}=0$ whenever $i<0$ or $j<b$. There is a decreasing filtration $L$ of $\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration] such that its degree-$n$ step $p$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] is the second-filtration image sum over $j\in[p,n]$. Its step at $b$ is the whole object in every degree, and its step at $n+1$ is zero in degree $n$.

source.place: Tags 012Z and 0132; thm-sp-if-e1 proof paragraph 1, filtration construction

proof.text: For total degree n the nonzero summands have first index i nonnegative and second index j at least b, with i+j=n. Thus b ≤ j ≤ n. For each p take the sum of the images of the diagonal inclusions with j in [p,n]. On a diagonal summand the horizontal differential preserves j and the vertical differential raises j by one. Both therefore factor through the next degree's step. Their signed sum does too. Choose these factorizations through the monomorphisms representing the steps. The equations for the squares of the differentials and the inclusion morphism follow by cancellation of those monomorphisms. This gives a subcomplex for each p. The inclusions of the image sums for p ≤ q give compatible inclusions of the subcomplexes, hence an antitone family of subobjects of the total complex. Evaluation of its inclusions has exactly the stated images. At p=b every nonzero diagonal summand occurs, so the coproduct universal property makes the image sum top. At p=n+1 the indexing interval is empty, so it is bottom. If n<b the total itself is zero, and these same equalities still hold.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedBelow_secondFiltration
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (J : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [J.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)]
    (b : ℤ)
    (hzero : ∀ i j : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ j < b → IsZero ((J.X i).X j)) :
    ∃ L : DecreasingFiltration (J.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ)),
      (∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n = (J.secondFiltration n).step p) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, L.complexStep b n = ⊤) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, L.complexStep (n + 1) n = ⊥)
